name: Memory Crystal
description: Scoped graph-aware persistent memory for AI agents via Memory Crystal

defaultRecallMode.description: Default recall mode for this agent. Controls which memory stores and categories are prioritized.

defaultRecallLimit.description: Default number of memories to recall per query. Lower values reduce per-turn injection volume for hot long-lived sessions.

debugRecallOutput.description: Debug mode. When true, recall-style prompts inject the full wake/recall/search/recent payload and instruct the agent to print it before answering.

turnCapture.description: Native turn-complete capture. When true (default), each completed assistant turn is POSTed once to /api/mcp/turn with an idempotent turnId ('openclaw-channel:' + FNV-1a-32 hex of JSON.stringify({sessionKey, messageId, userMessage, assistantMessage})) so re-deliveries and operators' dist patches dedupe server-side. Env override: MEMORY_CRYSTAL_TURN_CAPTURE. Turns are skipped (logged as '[crystal-capture] turn skipped reason=...') and captured via the legacy /api/mcp/log path instead when the toggle is off, the apiKey is absent or 'local', the sessionKey is missing, or context-engine full mode owns transcript logging.

channelScope.description: Optional. When set, all API calls are namespaced as {channelScope}:{peerId}. Use for multi-tenant or per-agent isolation. Example: 'myapp'

agentScopePolicies.description: Optional. Per-agent channel scope policies. Use this to mix peer-scoped agents (client isolation) and shared agents (open knowledge across chats) under one API key. When an agentId matches the current session, this policy overrides the global channelScope.

scope.description: Memory Crystal scope prefix for this agent, e.g. 'peer-coach' or 'peer-team'.

mode.description: peer = per-user/per-peer isolation (`scope:{peerId}`), shared = one shared bucket across chats (`scope:main`).

acceptOpenclawSessionKey.description: Opt-in for peer policies. When true, derive peer id from OpenClaw direct session keys shaped like agent:<agentId>:<channel>:<account>:direct:<peerId>, and provider-peer direct keys like telegram:<peerId> when the current hook context already matches this policy. Default false.

localSummaryInjection.description: Enable prompt-aware local summary injection. When true, relevant summaries from the local store are injected into the context window based on the current user query. Off by default because injection volume compounds on long-lived sessions; turn on per-agent when you need it.

localStoreEnabled.description: Enable the optional local SQLite store used for local summary injection and helper tools. Recommended off for long-running gateway deployments unless you explicitly need local compaction.

contextEngineMode.description: Controls how aggressively Memory Crystal participates in the OpenClaw context-engine lifecycle. full = richest context-engine behavior, reduced = bounded assembly/compaction, hook-only = lifecycle hooks and tools only.

localSummaryMaxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to spend on injected relevant local summaries.

maxMemories.description: Maximum number of memories to request from recall and surface in the injected block. Honored via this plugin config (bridged to the recall hook) or the MEMORY_CRYSTAL_MAX_MEMORIES env override, which takes precedence. Hard-capped at 20.

previewChars.description: Per-memory content preview cap (characters) in the injected recall block. Full content stays available via crystal_recall. Honored via this plugin config (bridged to the recall hook) or the MEMORY_CRYSTAL_PREVIEW_CHARS env override, which takes precedence. Capped at 2000.

compactRecall.description: Backend-controlled toggle, documented here for discoverability. The content-vs-recallText swap happens in the Memory Crystal backend deployment (convex/crystal/recall.ts), which reads its OWN MEMORY_CRYSTAL_COMPACT_RECALL env var. Setting this in the OpenClaw plugin config or host env does NOT change recall behavior — only the backend deployment's env does. Defaults to compact-on when the backend env is unset.

testedWith.note: Advisory only. Records host versions this plugin release was validated against. Does NOT block install on other versions; doctor scripts emit a soft warning on mismatch.

openclaw.note: Pinned baseline — matches MIN_OPENCLAW_VERSION in the update/install scripts. 2026.6.11 was rolled back, so recording it here made doctor flag clean pinned installs as untested.
